description: AI answers that mention a brand or keyword: up to 20 questions answered by Google AI Overviews or ChatGPT that mention it, with AI search volume, first / last seen and the pages the answer cites (no answer text), in 94 countries (ChatGPT: US English), from AI search answers, $0.21 a call. Use when tracking AI-search visibility (GEO). No mention is an empty answer, still charged. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.21 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

keyword.description: The brand or keyword (at most 80 characters, up to 10 words).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Defaults to en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

locationCode.description: Google Ads location code (geo target ID). Defaults to 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States, market.fallback).

platform.description: google (AI Overviews, default) or chat_gpt (United States, en only).

name: llm_mentions
title: AI answers mentioning a keyword (up to 20)
